svg.title: I membrane orientation
svg.text: Enterobacteria phage M13 · assembly protein · 348 aa · computational predictions

g.text: Model reports "outside" labels for this chain; without a membrane span these labels do not establish localization.

svg.text: Scale: horizontal extent of every loop, tail and span ∝ residue count on one shared axis (1 aa = 3.1 px). Membrane depth, loop height and path shape are schematic, not physical distances or a 3D fold.

Inside/outside are model-defined sides of a membrane; for a phage protein the relevant host membrane is not assigned here. Signal peptides use precursor numbering; cleavage is predicted, not demonstrated.
